Click here to continue shopping --> Shop by Category EFFECTS PEDALS, AMPS & ACCESSORIES Effects Pedals Power Supplies Amplifiers & Cabinets Microphones Guitar Accessories TUBES Vacuum Tubes Tube Sockets Tube Accessories & Boxes PARTS Speakers Capacitors Transformers Diecast Enclosures Potentiometers Knobs Jacks & Plugs Power Cords Switches Reverb Tanks & Accessories Batteries Fuse Holders Jewels & Pilot Lights Technician Tools Miscellaneous Parts EARBUDS & HEADPHONES MERCHANDISE Apparel Clocks, Picks & Pickguards Search ALL PRODUCTS EXPRESS ORDER ENTRY ABOUT EHX CONTACT US --> -->   You are here --> Online Store EFFECTS PEDALS, AMPS & ACCESSORIES Effects Pedals Distortion Nano Metal Muff Nano Metal Muff Click to enlarge --> Not Sold Online Find Dealer Item NANOMETALMUFF The EHX Nano Metal Muff was built for the player who demands nothing less than hard-hitting distortion and an intense, aggressive sound. It’s a combination of weaponized distortion and an extremely powerful EQ section that provides all the flexibility and tone-shaping needed to dial in an array of ultra-heavy sounds. The Nano Metal Muff’s newly designed noise gate is a superb addition to this high-gain pedal and eliminates unwanted hum when you stop playing. It features a noise floor threshold control (GATE) and its own LED to indicate when the gate is engaged. A compact footprint and intelligent, straight forward controls complete the picture.
